caption: How a hi team keeps its app's data. On the team's machine, production's box runs the released version on app/, the team's data folder, which owns the data and is snapshotted. At every release, and with hi team data fork, hi forks app/ into run/preview-base/: it hardlinks the files, which takes seconds and no disk. The preview's box mounts that fork read only, with run/preview-data/ over it: that folder holds the databases and the last day's files, copied in full, and whatever the preview writes. Nothing the preview does reaches production. The preview's model calls go through a socket of its own and stop for the day at a limit; settings marked production only aren't in the preview.
